remarks: Welcome to 64 Soundview Avenue. This fully renovated three-bedroom, two-full-bathroom apartment offers a rare two-level layout with fresh modern finishes throughout. Updated from top to bottom, the unit features new flooring, renovated bathrooms, a stylish new kitchen with new appliances, and a clean, move-in-ready feel from the moment you walk in.  The main level includes a bright living room, dining area, updated kitchen, two bedrooms, and two full bathrooms, including a generously sized primary bedroom. The second floor adds a spacious third bedroom, additional hall space, a walk-in closet, and utility/storage area, giving the home a flexible townhouse-style feel that is hard to find in a rental.  With approximately 1,500 square feet based on the floor plan estimate, this apartment offers excellent space, privacy, and functionality. Conveniently located in Stamford near shopping, dining, transportation, downtown, beaches, parks, and major commuter routes, this fully renovated home is a standout rental opportunity.
